summary: Feed s094_single to SIEM is degraded due to 18.6% duplicate packets (469/2522) exceeding 5% threshold. All other visibility checks (one-way, VLANs, encryption, drops, overload, truncation, tunnels, oversize) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Aggregation of multiple SPAN/TAP sources without packet-broker deduplication - same packet seen on two ingress ports forwarded twice to single SIEM tool port
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM wastes EPS/license/storage on 18.6% redundant events, risks inflated correlation counts and slower searches; no detection loss but significant efficiency and cost impact

recommended_fix.why: Enable broker deduplication to strip ~18.6% duplicates before SIEM, restoring EPS headroom and storage efficiency while preserving single copy for detection
